notes: Logo is the site's own 'H' monogram icon (180x180 PNG served for favicon.ico on harrydecruz.com), traced with logo_trace.py --colours 2 --keep-bg. The white serif H is the potrace trace; the dark-green (#005522) rounded square was replaced by an exact <rect rx> measured from the original (corner radius ~9% of width) because the traced corners were uneven. Mean absolute difference against the original on white: 2.56 (raw trace 2.48). It is a reconstruction, not the business's own vector file.

The logo is a monogram, not a full wordmark: the header 'Harry De Cruz' is live web-font text (ivypresto-display) with no logo image or SVG. Plate is 'none' because the mark carries its own solid green rounded-square background.

Reel: 2 video clips from his own 70 s Squarespace HLS showreel (harrydecruz.com/showreel; 1920x1080, audio stripped) plus 4 of his own photos as stills. The showreel is fast-cut (most shots under 1.8 s) and many shots carry burned-in title cards, quotes or client-brand logo walls, so only two text-free shots of 2 s or more were usable.

Gallery photos are his own published photos from harrydecruz.com (Squarespace CDN), fetched as JPEG and converted to WebP (max 1600 px, q80). Photo credits on his site include @domdommartin and Hannah McClune; use should be with consent.

Excluded from gallery and reel: IMG_1525 (wedding table shot with young children visible at the edge) and the 663A6149 headshot (a portrait, better suited as an avatar). IMG_4823 (wedding table magic) appears only in the reel, so the gallery does not carry two near-identical wedding-breakfast shots.

Oct 27 photo upgrade: card and gallery re-selected from original-resolution uploads on the business's own site and its own uploads on the old Booked Events site; AI renders, other businesses' images, private names and celebrity/watermarked shots excluded.
